summary: The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is developed, maintained and sponsored by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. The index is designed to measure the performance of securities of non-U.S. issuers whose primary business focus is Internet-related. The fund is non-diversified.
